bio.text: Katherine Clark has represented Massachusetts's 5th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives since 2013 and was elected House Democratic Whip in the fall of 2022.

Before Congress she served as a state senator, state representative, and member of the Melrose School Committee, and earlier as general counsel for the Massachusetts Office of Child Care Services and policy chief for the Massachusetts Attorney General.
She lives in Revere with her husband and has three children.
